generationInputs.prompt: The image shows a stylized design incorporating agricultural and fruit elements. A thick, dark green line, shaped like a stalk of wheat with visible segments and feathery awns, begins at the bottom left, arcs upwards and to the right, and then curves back down and slightly to the left, resembling the left side of a heart shape or a developing wheat stalk. Inside this green line are four stylized apple shapes, each a different color. The top apple is green and oriented diagonally from the upper left to the lower right. Below and slightly to the left of the green apple is a yellow apple pointing upwards and slightly to the left. A blue apple is positioned centrally, pointing downwards and slightly to the left. To the right of the blue apple is a red apple, oriented horizontally with its stem pointing towards the right. A thin, light green stem extends from the bottom of the blue apple and extends downwards, partially obscured by the red apple. The entire design is set against a plain white background. The style is flat and graphic, with solid colors and no shading or texture visible.
